source_snapshot.criteria: Each E1.S performance reaches customer SPEC.

source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Require immutable per-drive identity, empty/backup proof, runtime, four-profile numeric SPEC, destructive authorization and recovery.

old_problem: The destructive write profiles targeted the literal placeholder `/dev/sdx`; drive identity, raw-versus-filesystem policy, backup/empty proof, runtime, preconditioning, per-profile customer thresholds, health stops and data recovery were missing, while the DeepSeek version check exercised none of the required workload.
disposition_reason: The four fio workload semantics and all-E1.S coverage are explicit. ED-04 requires excluding every OS, mounted, RAID, LVM, device-mapper or data-bearing target; ED-03 permits exact serial/namespace targets, runtime and customer SPEC to be runtime/project configuration, and ED-15 keeps PASS closed until each numeric oracle is signed.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row381 all 18 XLSX columns, same-row DeepSeek material, GPT V2/history2974 and unique variant.
Analyzed each source fio profile independently: 2 MiB sequential read, 2 MiB sequential write, 4 KiB random read and 4 KiB random write, all with direct/libaio, depth16 and 16 jobs.
Retained every available E1.S and the 1500-minute machine allocation; destructive writes are permitted only after immutable identity and data-owner gates, never by `/dev/sdx` substitution.
Directly read next formal queue Compatibility row382 and verified its manifest identity; no fio, write, read or DUT action ran.

test_case.test_name: Per-drive identity-bound NVMe E1.S four-profile fio qualification
test_case.purpose: Benchmark every approved E1.S with the four source fio profiles and prove its bandwidth, IOPS and latency meet model-specific customer SPEC without touching any unapproved device or losing data.
required_package: Pinned fio/libaio/kernel/NVMe versions and approved job manifest
Explicit non-OS disposable raw namespace or allowlisted scratch-file policy, empty/backup proof, data-owner and destructive-write approval
Per-profile runtime, order, preconditioning/steady-state, repetitions, sampling and 1500-minute schedule
Model/profile-specific bandwidth, IOPS, latency statistic/percentile, units, floor/ceiling and tolerance
SMART/endurance/media/PCIe/thermal/power hard stops, restore and recovery
test_case.test_command: Never execute literal `/dev/sdx`. For each twice-verified allowlisted E1.S, freeze an identity-bound job manifest; capture SMART/media/thermal/PCIe baseline; run the exact 2 MiB sequential read, 2 MiB sequential write, 4 KiB random read and 4 KiB random write profiles one at a time with direct/libaio, depth16, jobs16 and the approved runtime; retain complete raw output, then verify device/data health and restore approved state before advancing to the next drive.
test_case.expected_result: Every required E1.S completes all four profiles for the approved runtime; each profile's signed bandwidth/IOPS/latency statistic meets its model-specific threshold/tolerance; no target identity drift, data-integrity failure, SMART/media/PCIe/thermal/power anomaly occurs; all targets finish in the approved restored state.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS is per drive and per profile and requires immutable target proof, full raw fio metrics, signed numeric thresholds and clean post-health/recovery evidence. fio availability, an aggregate result, missing profile, unknown `/dev/sdx` target or absent customer SPEC cannot pass.
safety_gate: Enumerate and exclude OS/boot/EFI/swap/mounted filesystems/LVM/RAID/device-mapper/unknown/data-bearing devices before any job
Require model+serial+namespace+stable path double-check, empty/backup proof and explicit data-owner destructive-write approval
Run one drive/profile at a time unless a separate concurrency SPEC is signed; account for write endurance and cooling
Preserve logs and abort on identity drift, data/media/SMART/PCIe reset/error, thermal or power limit; no automatic retry
expected_evidence: fio/kernel/NVMe versions and immutable per-drive job manifest
Every E1.S model/serial/namespace/BDF/slot/stable-path map plus exclusions and backup/empty approval
Runtime/preconditioning/repeat contract and per-model/profile customer SPEC
Complete raw outputs/exits for all four profiles with bandwidth/IOPS/latency statistics and threshold comparisons
Target integrity/restored state, abort/recovery if any and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On wrong-target indication, fio error, media/SMART/PCIe or safety event, terminate the active job without retry, preserve fio and device evidence, isolate only the affected E1.S, restore data solely from the approved backup/runbook, verify namespace and platform health, and quarantine the device if integrity cannot be proven.
